COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CLCON No. 549 of 2025
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Mr. Lalit Samant, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
2. Petitioner has alleged disobedience of 
order dated 02.01.2019 passed by learned 
Single Judge in WPSS No. 4375 of 2018, 
which was affirmed upto Hon’ble Supreme 
Court.
3. The order passed by Hon’ble Supreme 
Court is enclosed as Annexure 5. Perusal 
thereof reveals that SLP filed by State 
Government was converted to civil appeal 
and it was dismissed vide order dated 
15.10.2024. Thus, this Court finds 
substance in the submission made by 
learned counsel for the petitioner that 
contempt petition is filed well within 
limitation. 
4. Issue notice to opposite party no. 1 
returnable at an early date. 
5. List this case on 12.12.2025. 
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
 16.10.2025
Aswal

Mr. Lalit Samant, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Devesh Ghildiyal, learned Brief Holder for 
the State/contemnors.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that 
though the response affidavit has been filed by the 
respondents/contemnors, in that response affidavit, 
the respondents/contemnors are silent about the 
compliance of the order, rather, it has been stated 
that the matter has been referred to the superior 
officers. He further submits that the order passed by 
the Writ Court has been affirmed by the Hon’ble 
Apex Court.
4. Learned counsel for the respondents/
contemnors is directed to comply the order passed 
by Writ Court forthwith.
